anomalies.observed: The RJ45 jack's Ethernet signal and center-tap pins are individually unconnected. The SKW92A Ethernet nets are separate nets containing only U5 pins 1–4.
anomalies.expected: For the specified Ethernet jack and Ethernet-capable SKW92A interface to provide wired Ethernet, the jack's transformer-side signal connections must be wired to the appropriate module Ethernet port signals.

the RJ45 jack J5's data pads (TD+/TD-/RD+/RD-, center-taps, shield) all appear in the netlist as individually unconnected

anomalies.impact: The board's RJ45 jack cannot carry Ethernet data as connected; wired Ethernet through this connector will not function.

parsed.summary: The netlist leaves the RJ45 Ethernet signal pins unconnected, while the SKW92A Ethernet nets terminate at the module. Consequently, the board cannot provide wired Ethernet through its specified jack.
